interests: Suspenseful thrillers featuring highly competent investigators who solve complex crimes involving secret societies or high-level criminal organizations, often with a tightly constructed plot full of unexpected twists.

Dark psychological dramas exploring the tension between maintaining a normal life and confronting traumatic pasts, focusing on relationships strained by secrets and the desperate desire to protect loved ones from becoming like their abusers.

Gritty crime procedurals set in urban environments that blend graphic violence with intellectual puzzles, centering on detectives facing off against sophisticated adversaries while navigating personal stakes.
